purpose: Decision threshold fixed before any #178 real-model candidate timing
pairing: Both arms run the same six idle,mixed alternating trials with application ping/pong readiness before HTTP; pair by index 0,1,2 on reserved CPU16-23, OMP_NUM_THREADS=8.
baseline_gate: All 3 pairs must reproduce #174 material contention after app readiness: matching successful short finals, each mixed delay >=2s and >=2x idle, >=1 busy response, overlapping successful long with >=2 chunks.

candidate_rule.status: short final and long HTTP 200 in every trial, first short commit before long completion

scope: CPU pilot only; three matched trials, no p95/p99 or default enablement. Failure or missing trace is inconclusive/no-go, never silently excluded.
